relatedSnapshot.title: Name 29 — AIA comp applied to one workspace only; September charges collected on the other
relatedSnapshot.description:
Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

Conversation context: customer-initiated email to <email> on 2026-09-29 (conversation 215476161890415, open, unassigned). The contact (Name 29) says a signed addendum with AI Acquisition (AIA) dated 27 Aug 2026 granted three months of free Acquisity access plus domains and inboxes across two of his workspaces, "Name 29's Workspace" and "Company One". He says AIA (Name 30) already paused billing and credited August on Company One, while two charges ($192 and $185) just posted on the Name 29 workspace. He asks to (1) credit back those two charges on that workspace and (2) confirm the workspace is off billing for the rest of the three-month period. He states there is no urgency and that his concern is not repeating next cycle, and offers the signed addendum or an introduction to Name 30 for verification.

Taxonomy bucket: refund. Discretion note: needs-human.

Finding: the three-month comp is visible on only one of the two workspaces. On the Company One billing account a manual credit of $819.00 was applied on 2026-09-08 (exactly three months of that workspace's $273.00 monthly total) and $129.00 of it settled the 2026-09-28 invoice, leaving $690.00 standing. On the workspace named in the ask, nothing was credited: both 2026-09-29 charges were collected in full, there are no credit notes, no customer balance, and no balance transactions. The 2026-08-29 pair on that same workspace was also collected in full after the addendum date. Neither workspace is actually paused anywhere; both subscriptions keep renewing, so the sibling workspace's "pause" is a standing credit rather than a billing stop. Nothing in production links the AIA arrangement to either organization, and no approval or promise document is on file, so the addendum itself is unverified.

Exposure: $377.00 USD verified for the two 2026-09-29 charges the customer explicitly asks about (fully collected, unrefunded). A further $377.00 USD from the 2026-08-29 pair on the same workspace is also collected and unrefunded but was not explicitly claimed; if both post-addendum cycles are honored the total is $754.00 USD. Two further renewals inside the stated three-month window (around 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-29, $377.00 each) are the billing the customer asks to be taken off.

Proposed human action: verify the signed AIA addendum names the Name 29's Workspace and covers the period claimed. If it does, credit $377.00 on that billing account against charges <stripe-id> ($185.00) and <stripe-id> ($192.00), decide separately whether the 2026-08-29 pair is included, and apply the same standing-credit arrangement used on the sibling workspace for the remainder of the three months. Then confirm both points to the customer. No money has been moved.

Full readout: Billing investigation document on this ticket.
